scope: Arrow Shape Geometry & Shape Lifecycle Handler Fix

tasks.title: Normalize Arrow Preset Geometries in ShapeManager
tasks.description: In src/managers/ShapeManager.js (and src/elements/ShapeManager.js), map preset geometry aliases: map 'arrow' and 'right-arrow' to 'rightArrow', 'left-arrow' to 'leftArrow', 'up-arrow' to 'upArrow', and 'down-arrow' to 'downArrow'. Ensure output DrawingML writes valid <a:prstGeom prst="rightArrow"><a:avLst/></a:prstGeom> under <p:spPr>.

tasks.title: Ensure getShape, updateShape, and removeShape Support Connector and Arrow Nodes
tasks.description: Audit getShape, getShapes, updateShape, and removeShape in ShapeManager. Ensure selectors inspect both <p:sp> (standard shape) and <p:cxnSp> (connector) elements by matching against <p:cNvPr id="..."> and name="...". Ensure generated arrows always receive unique non-visual IDs and names.

tasks.title: Automated Arrow Lifecycle Integration Tests
tasks.description: Write integration tests in tests/integration/arrowLifecycle.test.js covering the full lifecycle: adding an arrow with type 'arrow' and 'rightArrow', querying it via getShape(), updating its dimensions/color via updateShape(), and verifying deletion via removeShape().
